title: A complex perfect modulo a nilpotent ideal is perfect

standard_prerequisites.name: A complex of projective R-modules representing K whose reduction modulo I is a given complex lifting the representative of the derived quotient exists
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the projective lifting P of K with P/IP the chosen finite complex.

standard_prerequisites.name: Nakayama's lemma: a finitely generated module over R whose reduction modulo a nilpotent ideal is finite projective over R/I is finite projective over R
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes each P^n is finite projective over R.

core_obligations: By the definition of perfect objects choose a finite complex of finite projective R/I-modules representing K tensor R/I (proof lines 20520-20522). By the lift-complex-projectives lemma there is a complex P of projective R-modules representing K with P/IP equal to the chosen complex (proof lines 20523-20525). Each P^n is projective over R and its reduction P^n/I P^n is finite projective over R/I; since I is nilpotent, Nakayama's lemma gives that P^n is a finitely generated projective R-module, so P is a finite complex of finite projective R-modules and K is perfect (proof lines 20526-20528).
proof_roadmap: Choose the finite projective representative over R/I (proof lines 20520-20522).
Lift to a projective complex over R and apply Nakayama termwise (proof lines 20523-20528).
difficulty_reason: 11 行、模幂零理想完美 ⇒ 完美：按 perfect 定义选 K⊗R/I 的有限有限投射代表；lift-complex-projectives 引理给代表 K 的投射 R-模复形 P 且 P/IP 即所选复形；每个 P^n 是投射 R-模、其模 I 约化在 R/I 上有限投射，由 Nakayama（代数章 NAK 引理）得 P^n 有限生成投射，故 P 是有限有限投射复形、K 完美。承重全在 span 内；3 处引用（2 同章、1 跨章）作导航桩。
